question: Two chords AB and CD of a circle intersect at point F inside the circle. If AF = 4 cm, BF = 6 cm and CF = 3 cm, then find the length of CD.
solution:
Given:

Two chords AB and CD of a circle intersect at point F inside the circle. If AF = 4 cm, BF = 6 cm and CF = 3 cm.

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ea632475e1e5d8390e24b2095bb26f5e95f95951c23e002aedf6b0135fadc1b.png] 

If PQ and RS are two chords of a circle that intersect at a point M, we can conclude

PM × QM = RM × SM

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6544abe630b24ce0a200b35b76e35e21e372104fa6f55390aca6c80e4b4da7f9.png] 

Accoding to the concept,

AF × BF = CF × DF

⇒ 4 × 6 = 3 × DF

⇒ DF = 24/3

⇒ DF = 8

Now, the length of CD

⇒ (CF + DF)

⇒ 3 + 8

⇒ 11 cm

**∴ The length of CD is 11 cm.**
